ayahs.en: By those [angels] lined up in rows
ayahs.e2: By those ˹angels˺ lined up in ranks

ayahs.en: And those who drive [the clouds]
ayahs.e2: and those who diligently drive ˹the clouds˺

ayahs.en: And those who recite the message
ayahs.e2: and those who recite the Reminder

ayahs.en: Indeed, your God is One
ayahs.e2: Surely your God is One

ayahs.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلۡمَشَٰرِقِ
ayahs.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises
ayahs.e2: ˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, and the Lord of all points of sunrise
ayahs.tr: Rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa Rabbul mashaariq

ayahs.ar: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلۡكَوَاكِبِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars for decoration
ayahs.tr: Innaa zaiyannas samaaa 'ad dunyaa bizeenatinil kawaakib

ayahs.ar: وَحِفۡظࣰ ا مِّن كُلِّ شَيۡطَٰنࣲ مَّارِدࣲ‏
ayahs.en: And as protection against every rebellious devil
ayahs.e2: and ˹for˺ protection from every rebellious devil
ayahs.tr: Wa hifzam min kulli Shaitaanim maarid

ayahs.ar: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبࣲ‏
ayahs.en: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side
ayahs.e2: They cannot listen to the highest assembly ˹of angels˺ for they are pelted from every side
ayahs.tr: Laa yassamma 'oona ilal mala il a'alaa wa yuqzafoona min kulli jaanib

ayahs.en: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment
ayahs.e2: ˹fiercely˺ driven away. And they will suffer an everlasting torment

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَنۡ خَطِفَ ٱلۡخَطۡفَةَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُۥ شِهَابࣱ ثَاقِبࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness]
ayahs.e2: But whoever manages to stealthily eavesdrop is ˹instantly˺ pursued by a piercing flare
ayahs.tr: Illaa man khatifal khatfata fa atba'ahoo shihaabun saaqib

ayahs.ar: فَٱسۡتَفۡتِهِمۡ أَهُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَم مَّنۡ خَلَقۡنَآۚ إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَٰهُم مِّن طِينࣲ لَّازِبِۭ
ayahs.en: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay
ayahs.e2: So ask them ˹O Prophet˺, which is harder to create: them or other marvels of Our creation? Indeed, We created them from a sticky clay
ayahs.tr: Fastaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnaa; innaa khalaqnaahum min teenil laazib

ayahs.en: But you wonder, while they mock
ayahs.e2: In fact, you are astonished ˹by their denial˺, while they ridicule ˹you˺

ayahs.en: And when they are reminded, they remember not
ayahs.e2: When they are reminded, they are never mindful

ayahs.en: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
ayahs.e2: And whenever they see a sign, they make fun of it
ayahs.tr: Wa izaa ra aw Aayatinw yastaskhiroon

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوٓاْ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحۡرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.en: And say, "This is not but obvious magic
ayahs.e2: saying, “This is nothing but pure magic
ayahs.tr: Wa qaalooo in haazaa illaa sihrum mubeen

ayahs.ar: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
ayahs.en: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected
ayahs.e2: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected
ayahs.tr: A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamab'oosoon

ayahs.en: And our forefathers [as well]
ayahs.e2: And our forefathers as well?”

ayahs.en: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible
ayahs.e2: Say, “Yes! And you will be fully humbled.”

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَإِذَا هُمۡ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.en: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing
ayahs.e2: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will see ˹it all˺
ayahs.tr: Fa innamaa hiya zajra tunw waahidatun fa izaa hum yanzuroon

ayahs.en: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense
ayahs.e2: They will cry, “Oh, woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”
ayahs.tr: Qa qaaloo yaa wailanaa haazaa Yawmud-Deen

ayahs.ar: هَٰذَا يَوۡمُ ٱلۡفَصۡلِ ٱلَّذِي كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.en: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny
ayahs.e2: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision which you used to deny.”
ayahs.tr: Haazaa Yawmul Faslil lazee kuntum bihee tukaziboon

ayahs.ar: ۞ٱحۡشُرُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ وَأَزۡوَٰجَهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.en: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
ayahs.e2: ˹Allah will say to the angels,˺ “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers, and whatever they used to worship
ayahs.tr: Uhshurul lazeena zalamoo wa azwaajahum wa maa kaanoo ya'budoon

ayahs.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهۡدُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.en: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
ayahs.e2: instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell
ayahs.tr: Min doonil laahi fahdoohum ilaa siraatil Jaheem

ayahs.en: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned
ayahs.e2: And detain them, for they must be questioned.”

ayahs.en: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other
ayahs.e2: ˹Then they will be asked,˺ “What is the matter with you that you can no longer help each other?”

ayahs.en: But they, that Day, are in surrender
ayahs.e2: In fact, on that Day they will be ˹fully˺ submissive

ayahs.en: And they will approach one another blaming each other
ayahs.e2: They will turn on each other, throwing blame

ayahs.ar: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّكُمۡ كُنتُمۡ تَأۡتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ
ayahs.en: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right
ayahs.e2: The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”

ayahs.en: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers
ayahs.e2: The misleaders will reply, “No! You disbelieved on your own

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيۡكُم مِّن سُلۡطَٰنِۭۖ بَلۡ كُنتُمۡ قَوۡمࣰ ا طَٰغِينَ
ayahs.en: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people
ayahs.e2: We had no authority over you. In fact, you yourselves were a transgressing people
ayahs.tr: Wa maa kaana lanaa 'alaikum min sultaanim bal kuntum qawman taagheen

ayahs.ar: فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡنَا قَوۡلُ رَبِّنَآۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
ayahs.en: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment]
ayahs.e2: The decree of our Lord has come to pass against us ˹all˺: we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺

ayahs.en: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators
ayahs.e2: We caused you to deviate, for we ourselves were deviant.”

ayahs.en: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment
ayahs.e2: Surely on that Day they will ˹all˺ share in the punishment

ayahs.en: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals
ayahs.e2: That is certainly how We deal with the wicked

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسۡتَكۡبِرُونَ
ayahs.en: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
ayahs.e2: For whenever it was said to them ˹in the world˺, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah,” they acted arrogantly
ayahs.tr: Innahum kaanooo izaa qeela lahum laaa ilaaha illal laahu yastakbiroon

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرࣲ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
ayahs.en: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet
ayahs.e2: and argued, “Should we really abandon our gods for a mad poet?”
ayahs.tr: Wa yaqooloona a'innaa lataarikooo aalihatinaa lishaa'irim majnoon

ayahs.en: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers
ayahs.e2: In fact, he came with the truth, confirming ˹earlier˺ messengers
ayahs.tr: bal jaaa'a bilhaqqi wa saddaqal mursaleen

ayahs.en: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment
ayahs.e2: You will certainly taste the painful torment

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
ayahs.en: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do
ayahs.e2: and will only be rewarded for what you used to do
ayahs.tr: Wa maa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon

ayahs.en: But not the chosen servants of Allah
ayahs.e2: But not the chosen servants of Allah

ayahs.en: Those will have a provision determined
ayahs.e2: They will have a known provision

ayahs.en: Fruits; and they will be honored
ayahs.e2: fruits ˹of every type˺. And they will be honoured

ayahs.en: In gardens of pleasure
ayahs.e2: in the Gardens of Bliss

ayahs.en: On thrones facing one another
ayahs.e2: facing each other on thrones

ayahs.en: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring
ayahs.e2: A drink ˹of pure wine˺ will be passed around to them from a flowing stream

ayahs.en: White and delicious to the drinkers
ayahs.e2: crystal-white, delicious to drink

ayahs.ar: لَا فِيهَا غَوۡلࣱ وَلَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا يُنزَفُونَ
ayahs.en: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated
ayahs.e2: It will neither harm ˹them˺, nor will they be intoxicated by it
ayahs.tr: Laa feehaa ghawlunw wa laa hum 'anhaa yunzafoon

ayahs.en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes
ayahs.e2: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and gorgeous eyes

ayahs.en: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected
ayahs.e2: as if they were pristine pearls

ayahs.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other
ayahs.e2: Then they will turn to one another inquisitively

ayahs.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ إِنِّي كَانَ لِي قَرِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
ayahs.e2: One of them will say, “I once had a companion ˹in the world˺
ayahs.tr: Qaala qaaa'ilum minhum innee kaana lee qareen

ayahs.en: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
ayahs.e2: who used to ask ˹me˺, ‘Do you actually believe ˹in resurrection˺

ayahs.ar: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ ا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
ayahs.en: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed
ayahs.e2: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be brought to judgment?’”
ayahs.tr: A-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamadeenoon

ayahs.en: He will say, "Would you [care to] look
ayahs.e2: He will ˹then˺ ask, “Would you care to see ˹his fate˺?”

ayahs.en: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire
ayahs.e2: Then he ˹and the others˺ will look and spot him in the midst of the Hellfire
ayahs.tr: Fattala'a fara aahu fee sawaaa'il Jaheem

ayahs.en: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me
ayahs.e2: He will ˹then˺ say, “By Allah! You nearly ruined me

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡلَا نِعۡمَةُ رَبِّي لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلۡمُحۡضَرِينَ
ayahs.en: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell]
ayahs.e2: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I ˹too˺ would have certainly been among those brought ˹to Hell˺.”
ayahs.tr: Wa law laa ni'matu Rabbee lakuntu minal muhdareen

ayahs.en: Then, are we not to die
ayahs.e2: ˹Then he will ask his fellow believers,˺ “Can you imagine that we will never die

ayahs.ar: إِلَّا مَوۡتَتَنَا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.en: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished
ayahs.e2: except our first death, nor be punished ˹like the others˺?”
ayahs.tr: Illa mawtatanal oola wa maa nahnu bimu'azzabeen

ayahs.en: Indeed, this is the great attainment
ayahs.e2: This is truly the ultimate triumph

ayahs.en: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work
ayahs.e2: For such ˹honour˺ all should strive

ayahs.ar: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرࣱ نُّزُلًا أَمۡ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.en: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum
ayahs.e2: Is this ˹bliss˺ a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqûm
ayahs.tr: Azaalika khairun nuzulan am shajaratuz Zaqqom

ayahs.en: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers
ayahs.e2: We have surely made it a test for the wrongdoers

ayahs.ar: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةࣱ تَخۡرُجُ فِيٓ أَصۡلِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire
ayahs.e2: Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell
ayahs.tr: Innahaa shajaratun takhruju feee aslil Jaheem

ayahs.en: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils
ayahs.e2: bearing fruit like devils’ heads

ayahs.ar: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
ayahs.en: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies
ayahs.e2: The evildoers will certainly ˹be left to˺ eat from it, filling up their bellies with it
ayahs.tr: Fa innahum la aakiloona minhaa famaali'oona minhal butoon

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمۡ عَلَيۡهَا لَشَوۡبࣰ ا مِّنۡ حَمِيمࣲ‏
ayahs.en: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water
ayahs.e2: Then on top of that they will be given a blend of boiling drink
ayahs.tr: Summa inna lahum 'alaihaa lashawbam min hameem

ayahs.en: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire
ayahs.e2: Then they will ultimately return to ˹their place in˺ Hell
ayahs.tr: Summa inna marji'ahum la ilal Jaheem

ayahs.en: Indeed they found their fathers astray
ayahs.e2: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray

ayahs.en: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps
ayahs.e2: so they rushed in their footsteps

ayahs.en: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples
ayahs.e2: And surely most of the earlier generations had strayed before them
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad dalla qablahum aksarul awwaleen

ayahs.en: And We had already sent among them warners
ayahs.e2: although We had certainly sent warners among them

ayahs.en: Then look how was the end of those who were warned
ayahs.e2: See then what was the end of those who had been warned

ayahs.en: But not the chosen servants of Allah
ayahs.e2: But not the chosen servants of Allah

ayahs.en: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders
ayahs.e2: Indeed, Noah cried out to Us, and how excellent are We in responding
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad naadaanaa Noohun falani'mal mujeeboon

ayahs.en: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction
ayahs.e2: We delivered him and his family from the great distress
ayahs.tr: Wa jajainaahu wa ahlahoo minal karbil 'azeem

ayahs.en: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
ayahs.e2: and made his descendants the sole survivors

ayahs.en: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
ayahs.e2: And We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

ayahs.en: Peace upon Noah among the worlds
ayahs.e2: “Peace be upon Noah among all peoples.”

ayahs.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.e2: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

ayahs.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
ayahs.e2: ˹For˺ he was truly one of Our faithful servants

ayahs.en: Then We drowned the disbelievers
ayahs.e2: Then We drowned the others

ayahs.en: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham
ayahs.e2: And indeed, one of those who followed his way was Abraham
ayahs.tr: Wa ina min shee'atihee la Ibraaheem

ayahs.en: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember˺ when he came to his Lord with a pure heart
ayahs.tr: Iz jaaa'a Rabbahoo bi qalbin saleem

ayahs.ar: إِذۡ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوۡمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعۡبُدُونَ
ayahs.en: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship
ayahs.e2: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshipping
ayahs.tr: Iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maazaa ta'budoon

ayahs.en: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire
ayahs.e2: Is it false gods that you desire instead of Allah

ayahs.en: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds
ayahs.e2: What then do you expect from the Lord of all worlds?”

ayahs.en: And he cast a look at the stars
ayahs.e2: He later looked up to the stars ˹in contemplation˺

ayahs.en: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill
ayahs.e2: then said, “I am really sick.”

ayahs.en: So they turned away from him, departing
ayahs.e2: So they turned their backs on him and went away

ayahs.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمۡ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
ayahs.en: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat
ayahs.e2: Then he ˹stealthily˺ advanced towards their gods, and said ˹mockingly˺, “Will you not eat ˹your offerings˺
ayahs.tr: Faraagha ilaaa aalihatihim faqaala alaa taakuloon

ayahs.en: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak
ayahs.e2: What is wrong with you that you cannot speak?”

ayahs.en: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand
ayahs.e2: Then he swiftly turned on them, striking ˹them˺ with his right hand

ayahs.en: Then the people came toward him, hastening
ayahs.e2: Later, his people came rushing towards him ˹furiously˺

ayahs.en: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve
ayahs.e2: He argued, “How can you worship what you carve ˹with your own hands˺

ayahs.en: While Allah created you and that which you do
ayahs.e2: when it is Allah Who created you and whatever you do?”

ayahs.ar: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنࣰ ا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
ayahs.en: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire
ayahs.e2: They said ˹to one another˺, “Build him a furnace and cast him into the blazing fire.”
ayahs.tr: Qaalub noo lahoo bun yaanan fa alqoohu fil jaheem

ayahs.ar: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدࣰ ا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَسۡفَلِينَ
ayahs.en: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased
ayahs.e2: And so they sought to harm him, but We made them inferior
ayahs.tr: Fa araadoo bihee kaidan faja 'alnaahumul asfaleen

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
ayahs.en: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me
ayahs.e2: He later said, “I am leaving ˹in obedience˺ to my Lord. He will guide me
ayahs.tr: Wa qaala innee zaahibun ilaa Rabbee sa yahdeen

ayahs.en: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous
ayahs.e2: My Lord! Bless me with righteous offspring.”

ayahs.en: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy
ayahs.e2: So We gave him good news of a forbearing son

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعۡيَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيٓ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلۡمَنَامِ أَنِّيٓ أَذۡبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرۡ مَاذَا تَرَىٰۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفۡعَلۡ مَا تُؤۡمَرُۖ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.en: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast
ayahs.e2: Then when the boy reached the age to work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son! I have seen in a dream that I ˹must˺ sacrifice you. So tell me what you think.” He replied, “O my dear father! Do as you are commanded. Allah willing, you will find me steadfast.”
ayahs.tr: Falamma balagha ma'a hus sa'ya qaala yaa buniya inneee araa fil manaami anneee azbahuka fanzur maazaa taraa; qaala yaaa abatif 'al maa tu'maru satajidunee in shaaa'allaahu minas saabireen

ayahs.en: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead
ayahs.e2: Then when they submitted ˹to Allah’s Will˺, and Abraham laid him on the side of his forehead ˹for sacrifice˺

ayahs.en: We called to him, "O Abraham
ayahs.e2: We called out to him, “O Abraham

ayahs.ar: قَدۡ صَدَّقۡتَ ٱلرُّءۡيَآۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
ayahs.en: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.e2: You have already fulfilled the vision.” Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers
ayahs.tr: Qad saddaqtar ru'yaa; innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen

ayahs.en: Indeed, this was the clear trial
ayahs.e2: That was truly a revealing test

ayahs.en: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice
ayahs.e2: And We ransomed his son with a great sacrifice

ayahs.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
ayahs.e2: and blessed Abraham ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

ayahs.en: Peace upon Abraham
ayahs.e2: “Peace be upon Abraham.”

ayahs.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.e2: This is how We reward the good-doers

ayahs.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
ayahs.e2: He was truly one of Our faithful servants

ayahs.ar: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيࣰّ ا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.en: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous
ayahs.e2: We ˹later˺ gave him good news of Isaac—a prophet, and one of the righteous
ayahs.tr: Wa bashsharnaahu bi Ishaaqa Nabiyayam minas saaliheen

ayahs.ar: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنࣱ وَظَالِمࣱ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself
ayahs.e2: We blessed him and Isaac as well. Some of their descendants did good, while others clearly wronged themselves
ayahs.tr: Wa baaraknaa 'alaihi wa 'alaaa Ishaaq; wa min zurriyya tihimaa muhsinunw wa zaalimul linafshihee mubeen

ayahs.en: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron
ayahs.e2: And We certainly showed favour to Moses and Aaron
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad mananna alaa Moosaa wa Haaroon

ayahs.en: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction
ayahs.e2: and delivered them and their people from the great distress
ayahs.tr: Wa najjainaahumaa wa qawmahumaa minal karbil 'azeem

ayahs.en: And We supported them so it was they who overcame
ayahs.e2: We helped them so it was they who prevailed

ayahs.en: And We gave them the explicit Scripture
ayahs.e2: We gave them the clear Scripture

ayahs.en: And We guided them on the straight path
ayahs.e2: and guided them to the Straight Path

ayahs.en: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations
ayahs.e2: And We blessed them ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

ayahs.en: Peace upon Moses and Aaron
ayahs.e2: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”

ayahs.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.e2: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

ayahs.en: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants
ayahs.e2: They were truly ˹two˺ of Our faithful servants

ayahs.en: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers
ayahs.e2: And Elias was indeed one of the messengers

ayahs.en: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his people, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

ayahs.ar: أَتَدۡعُونَ بَعۡلࣰ ا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحۡسَنَ ٱلۡخَٰلِقِينَ
ayahs.en: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators
ayahs.e2: Do you call upon ˹the idol of˺ Ba’l and abandon the Best of Creators—
ayahs.tr: Atad'oona Ba'lanw wa tazaroona ahsanal khaaliqeen

ayahs.en: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers
ayahs.e2: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”
ayahs.tr: Allaaha Rabbakum wa Rabba aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

ayahs.en: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment]
ayahs.e2: But they rejected him, so they will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺

ayahs.en: Except the chosen servants of Allah
ayahs.e2: But not the chosen servants of Allah

ayahs.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations
ayahs.e2: We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

ayahs.en: Peace upon Elias
ayahs.e2: “Peace be upon Elias.”

ayahs.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good
ayahs.e2: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

ayahs.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants
ayahs.e2: He was truly one of Our faithful servants

ayahs.en: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers
ayahs.e2: And Lot was indeed one of the messengers

ayahs.en: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember˺ when We delivered him and all of his family

ayahs.en: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers]
ayahs.e2: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed

ayahs.en: Then We destroyed the others
ayahs.e2: Then We ˹utterly˺ destroyed the rest

ayahs.en: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
ayahs.e2: You ˹Meccans˺ certainly pass by their ruins day

ayahs.en: And at night. Then will you not use reason
ayahs.e2: and night. Will you not then understand

ayahs.en: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers
ayahs.e2: And Jonah was indeed one of the messengers

ayahs.en: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship
ayahs.e2: ˹Remember˺ when he fled to the overloaded ship
ayahs.tr: Iz abaqa ilal fulkil mash hoon

ayahs.en: And he drew lots and was among the losers
ayahs.e2: Then ˹to save it from sinking,˺ he drew straws ˹with other passengers˺. He lost ˹and was thrown overboard˺

ayahs.en: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy
ayahs.e2: Then the whale engulfed him while he was blameworthy

ayahs.en: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah
ayahs.e2: Had he not ˹constantly˺ glorified ˹Allah˺
ayahs.tr: Falaw laaa annahoo kaana minal musabbiheen

ayahs.ar: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطۡنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.en: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected
ayahs.e2: he would have certainly remained in its belly until the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.tr: Lalabisa fee batniheee ilaa Yawmi yub'asoon

ayahs.en: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill
ayahs.e2: But We cast him onto the open ˹shore˺, ˹totally˺ worn out

ayahs.en: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine
ayahs.e2: and caused a squash plant to grow over him

ayahs.ar: وَأَرۡسَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِاْئَةِ أَلۡفٍ أَوۡ يَزِيدُونَ
ayahs.en: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more
ayahs.e2: We ˹later˺ sent him ˹back˺ to ˹his city of˺ at least one hundred thousand people
ayahs.tr: Wa arsalnaahu ilaa mi'ati alfin aw yazeedoon

ayahs.en: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time
ayahs.e2: who then believed ˹in him˺, so We allowed them enjoyment for a while
ayahs.tr: Fa aamanoo famatta' naahum ilaa heen

ayahs.en: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons
ayahs.e2: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ if your Lord has daughters, while the pagans ˹prefer to˺ have sons
ayahs.tr: Fastaftihim ali Rabbikal banaatu wa lahumul banoon

ayahs.ar: أَمۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثࣰ ا وَهُمۡ شَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.en: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses
ayahs.e2: Or ˹ask them˺ if We created the angels as females right before their eyes
ayahs.tr: Am khalaqnal malaaa'i kata inaasanw wa hm shaahidoon

ayahs.en: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say
ayahs.e2: Indeed, it is one of their ˹outrageous˺ fabrications to say
ayahs.tr: Alaaa innahum min ifkihim la yaqooloon

ayahs.en: Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars
ayahs.e2: “Allah has children.” They are simply liars

ayahs.en: Has He chosen daughters over sons
ayahs.e2: Has He chosen daughters over sons

ayahs.en: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement
ayahs.e2: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

ayahs.en: Then will you not be reminded
ayahs.e2: Will you not then be mindful

ayahs.en: Or do you have a clear authority
ayahs.e2: Or do you have ˹any˺ compelling proof

ayahs.en: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful
ayahs.e2: Then bring ˹us˺ your scripture, if what you say is true
ayahs.tr: Faatoo bi Kitaabikum in kuntum saadiqeen

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيۡنَهُۥ وَبَيۡنَ ٱلۡجِنَّةِ نَسَبࣰ اۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَلِمَتِ ٱلۡجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمۡ لَمُحۡضَرُونَ
ayahs.en: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment]
ayahs.e2: They have also established a ˹marital˺ relationship between Him and the jinn. Yet the jinn ˹themselves˺ know well that such people will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'aloo bainahoo wa bainal jinnati nasabaa; wa laqad 'alimatil jinnatu innahum lamuhdaroon

ayahs.en: Exalted is Allah above what they describe
ayahs.e2: Glorified is Allah far above what they claim

ayahs.en: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin]
ayahs.e2: But not the chosen servants of Allah

ayahs.en: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship
ayahs.e2: Surely you ˹pagans˺ and whatever ˹idols˺ you worship

ayahs.en: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
ayahs.e2: can never lure ˹anyone˺ away from Him

ayahs.en: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire
ayahs.e2: except those ˹destined˺ to burn in Hell

ayahs.ar: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامࣱ مَّعۡلُومࣱ‏
ayahs.en: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position
ayahs.e2: ˹The angels respond,˺ “There is not one of us without an assigned station ˹of worship˺
ayahs.tr: Wa maa minnasa illaa lahoo maqaamum ma'loom

ayahs.en: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer]
ayahs.e2: We are indeed the ones lined up in ranks ˹for Allah˺

ayahs.en: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah
ayahs.e2: And we are indeed the ones ˹constantly˺ glorifying ˹His praise˺.”

ayahs.en: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say
ayahs.e2: They certainly used to say

ayahs.ar: لَوۡ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكۡرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.en: If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples
ayahs.e2: “If only we had a Reminder like ˹those of˺ earlier peoples

ayahs.en: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah
ayahs.e2: we would have truly been Allah’s devoted servants.”

ayahs.en: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know
ayahs.e2: But ˹now˺ they reject it, so they will soon know

ayahs.en: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers
ayahs.e2: Our Word has already gone forth to Our servants, the messengers
ayahs.tr: Wa laqad sabaqat Kalimatunaa li'ibaadinal mursa leen

ayahs.en: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
ayahs.e2: that they would surely be helped

ayahs.en: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome
ayahs.e2: and that Our forces will certainly prevail

ayahs.en: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time
ayahs.e2: So turn away from the deniers for a while ˹O Prophet˺

ayahs.en: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see
ayahs.e2: You will see ˹what will happen to˺ them, and they too will see

ayahs.en: Then for Our punishment are they impatient
ayahs.e2: Do they ˹really˺ wish to hasten Our punishment

ayahs.ar: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمۡ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلۡمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.en: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned
ayahs.e2: Yet when it descends upon them: how evil will that morning be for those who had been warned
ayahs.tr: Fa izaa nazala bisaahatihim fasaaa'a sabaahul munzareen

ayahs.en: And leave them for a time
ayahs.e2: And turn away from them for a while

ayahs.en: And see, for they are going to see
ayahs.e2: You will see, and they too will see

ayahs.ar: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلۡعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.en: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe
ayahs.e2: Glorified is your Lord—the Lord of Honour and Power—above what they claim

ayahs.en: And peace upon the messengers
ayahs.e2: Peace be upon the messengers

ayahs.en: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds
ayahs.e2: And praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds
